model_under_test.note: Intermediate checkpoints (session_000..session_046) are used only for training-curve analysis -- never as a candidate for the formal comparison itself.

arms.description: PPO-V2, deterministic inference with the safety-aware tie rule R1-R6 (CORR-58).
HPA-V2, CPU-only metric, V2 replica floor (demo-app-hpa-v2-cpu).

common_arm_conditions.image: same demo-app image for all three arms (no per-arm rebuild)
common_arm_conditions.metrics_server_resolution_verified_befor: 15s, verified live immediately before each HPA-arm run, never assumed

workloads.order: Rotated per repeat using a Latin square over the 3 arms (so no arm is always first/last within a repeat); the exact realized order for every (profile, repeat) cell must be recorded in the evaluation run's own output before any result is read.

epsilon_rule.definition: epsilon = 10th percentile of the final model's (session_047) top1-top2 action-probability margin (action_selection.compute_margin_stats().margin), computed over observations drawn from the LAST 5 TRAINING sessions' own step_telemetry.jsonl (sessions 043-047 under the amended 48-session budget).
epsilon_rule.when_computed: Once, before evaluation begins -- never re-tuned after seeing any evaluation result.
epsilon_rule.value_note: Computed 2026-11-13 (V2 Phase 5D, post-training) via scripts/calibrate_epsilon_v2.py --official against session_047 (model sha256 d58e50184d353e2b183cf7b30a8b0cddeea3cac7a79e742496a0c4e5a3922d3f) and the last 5 sessions (043-047), n=1280 observations. Raw (uncapped) 10th-percentile margin was 0.4503 -- the cap (0.05) is what binds, not the raw percentile. tie_fraction_at_epsilon=0.00547 (0.55% of decisions). Full record: persistent-data/rl_training_v2/final_min2/EPSILON_CALIBRATION.json.
epsilon_rule.current_provisional_epsilon_in_configs_r: 0.05 (near_tie_epsilon, status: provisional_unvalidated -- this pre-registration's own computed value supersedes it for evaluation purposes only; training itself is unaffected, CORR-58 scope note)

primary: sla_violation_rate_at_1000ms (share of decisions with p95_latency_ms >= 1000ms, the current CORR-57 SLA target)
replica_minutes (cost: integral of replica count over time)
reference_only: sla_violation_rate_at_300ms (the pre-CORR-57 target, reported for historical comparability only -- NOT the primary SLA definition for this evaluation)

validity_rules.tooling_failure: A run invalidated by a tooling/infrastructure failure (route unreachable, Prometheus unavailable, cluster/network fault) has NO scientific outcome -- it is retried exactly once. The failed attempt's evidence is preserved, never deleted.
validity_rules.safety_termination: A run that ends via a safety termination (e.g. memory threshold breach, zero ready replicas) IS a scientific outcome for that arm/profile/repeat cell -- it is counted as-is and is NEVER retried.
validity_rules.every_attempt_preserved: Every attempt (successful, tooling-failed, or safety-terminated), including the single tooling-failure retry, is preserved on disk under its own directory -- no attempt's evidence is ever overwritten or deleted.

decision_rule.reporting: Per profile, per arm: report mean +/- standard deviation over the 3 repeats for every metric.
decision_rule.claiming_better: An arm may be claimed 'better' than another on a given metric for a given profile ONLY if it is better in ALL 3 of the 3 repeats (not merely on average) -- a single repeat going the other way blocks the claim for that metric/profile pair.
decision_rule.no_aggregate_winner: No single aggregate 'winner' is declared across metrics that disagree (e.g. one arm has a lower SLA-violation rate but higher replica-minutes) -- such cases are reported explicitly as a trade-off, not resolved into a single ranking.

scope.statement: Evaluation-only code changes made after this record (V2 Phase 5B: implementing scripts/evaluate_ppo_vs_hpa_v2.py changes, the CPU-only-HPA controller_exclusivity extension, etc.) do not affect training in any way -- training's own governing files and FREEZE_MANIFEST.json (plus AMENDMENT_001) remain the sole authority for what was learned. Every evaluation-code file's SHA-256 hash will be recorded in a dedicated evaluation-code manifest BEFORE the first evaluation run executes, so the exact code version that produced each result is always reconstructable.
